info.title: HukID Console BFF and Operator — AUTH-T02
info.description: New console-owned contract, not the missing historical HukID OpenAPI. Executable schema baseline for isolated tests; AUTH-T04 login/callback handlers are implemented for isolated tests; no production interoperability is claimed. camelCase HTTP fields. Tenant authority comes from active local memberships, never browser role/tenant claims. Do not send console cookies to Management. CSRF is a synchronizer token, not an access token.

Set-Cookie.description: Opaque session/transaction cookies only. HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax; no Domain. This test profile permits HTTP loopback; production cookie policy is not approved.

get.description: AUTH-T04 handler implemented for the explicit isolated test profile. All responses are no-store and correlated; codes/cookies/tokens must not be logged. Exactly one of code or error is required together with state and the HttpOnly transaction binding cookie. Reject duplicate parameters, invalid state/nonce/issuer/PKCE/replay. OAuth error_description is never reflected or logged. A valid ID token establishes identity only; Management requires its own access token.

post.description: AUTH-T02 contract only; handler is not implemented. All responses are no-store and correlated; codes/cookies/tokens must not be logged. Requires same-origin and a session-bound CSRF proof. An already invalidated family returns 204 for authenticated retries while its CSRF tombstone is retained until the original absolute expiry; an absent/unverifiable proof returns 403 without side effects. A tombstone never authorizes protected reads. IdP outage cannot prevent local invalidation. No idempotency header for session commands.

oidcTransaction.name: hukid_test_transaction
oidcTransaction.description: HttpOnly browser binding for a single-use OIDC transaction, not an authenticated session.

consoleSession.name: hukid_test_session
consoleSession.description: Opaque server-side test session; no tokens in JS storage.

csrfToken.name: X-CSRF-Token
csrfToken.description: 256-bit session-bound synchronizer token supplied by console /me; check in constant time plus exact Origin.

operatorBearer.description: ES256, typ=at+jwt, configured issuer/client_id, exact scalar operator audience, hukid_token_class=operator, hukid_grant=authorization_code, valid time, MFA evidence and operator:read. Never an ID token.
